limitations: This is evidence packaging, never a test PASS, deployment or publication record.
Every original FAIL/PENDING/bridge/status and raw reference remains unchanged; resolve original paths or SHA through this manifest.
PNG/PDF and other captured raster evidence are not edited; exact-byte duplicate binaries share one archived file and retain every original-path mapping.
Only files actually present at scan time are included. Pages and visual completion must be established separately by Root.
No environment variables, credential files, other-repository source directories or build output are collected. Unrecognized files need explicit disposition before apply.
